bio_en: Ruben Shishmanian, known as Keri, was a native of Erzincan from the prosperous Shishmanian family, educated at the Erzincan national central school, who with his brother Grigor administered the monastery of St. Lusavorich on the slopes of Mount Sepuh. One of the pioneers of the revolution in his region, he first served in Galust Arkhanian's band and, before its arrest, organised with the Erzincan committee a new band that terrorised oppressive Turkish and Kurdish beys and protected Armenian villages between Kamakh and Dersim during the 1895 massacres. In August 1895 his 17-man band attacked a military party in the Kamakh gorge and then held out on Mount Sepuh, a fight that drew European attention. His comrades included Kaytsak Arakel and Avo.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Not the same as Keri (Arshak Gavafian). Dates of life not read.
